'''Zvika Brakerski''' ({{Langx|he|צביקה ברקרסקי}}) is an Israeli cryptographer and associate professor in the Department of Computer Science and Applied Mathematics at the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]]. He is known for his work on [[homomorphic encryption]], particularly in developing the foundations of second generation FHE schema, for which he was awarded the 2022 [[Gödel Prize]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=ACM SIGACT - Gödel Prize |url=https://sigact.org/prizes/g%C3%B6del.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221124152356/https://sigact.org/prizes/g%C3%B6del.html | archive-date=2022-11-24 |access-date=2022-11-24 |website=sigact.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=School of Engineering second quarter 2022 awards |url=https://news.mit.edu/2022/school-engineering-second-quarter-awards-0725 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221124152146/https://news.mit.edu/2022/school-engineering-second-quarter-awards-0725 |archive-date=2022-11-24 |access-date=2022-11-24 |website=MIT News {{!}} Massachusetts Institute of Technology |language=en}}</ref>

==Research==
In 2011, Brakerski and [[Vinod Vaikuntanathan]] introduced a scheme for fully homomorphic encryption based on the [[learning with errors]] problem.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Brakerski |first=Zvika |last2=Vaikuntanathan |first2=Vinod |date=2014 |title=Efficient Fully Homomorphic Encryption from (Standard) $\mathsf{LWE}$ |url=http://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/120868669 |journal=SIAM Journal on Computing |language=en |volume=43 |issue=2 |pages=831–871 |doi=10.1137/120868669 |issn=0097-5397|hdl=1721.1/115488 |hdl-access=free |url-access=subscription }}</ref> Later with [[Craig Gentry (computer scientist)|Craig Gentry]], they constructed the Brakerski-Gentry-Vaikuntanathan (BGV) scheme, which can be instantiated in leveled mode without bootstrapping.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Brakerski |first1=Zvika |last2=Gentry |first2=Craig |last3=Vaikuntanathan |first3=Vinod |date=2011 |title=Fully Homomorphic Encryption without Bootstrapping |url=https://eprint.iacr.org/2011/277 |journal=Cryptology ePrint Archive |language=en}}</ref> For these works, Brakerski, Vaikuntanathan, and Gentry were jointly awarded the Gödel Prize in 2022.

In 2012 Brakerski published a paper at the Annual Cryptology Conference ''Fully homomorphic encryption without modulus switching from classical GapSVP''.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Brakerski |first=Zvika |title=Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2012 |chapter=Fully Homomorphic Encryption without Modulus Switching from Classical GapSVP |series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science |date=2012 |volume=7417 |editor-last=Safavi-Naini |editor-first=Reihaneh |editor2-last=Canetti |editor2-first=Ran |language=en |location=Berlin, Heidelberg |publisher=Springer |pages=868–886 |doi=10.1007/978-3-642-32009-5_50 |isbn=978-3-642-32009-5|doi-access=free }}</ref> This paper formed the basis of the BFV scheme which, along with BGV, is one of the most well-known second-generation FHE schema.
